responsibility: Declares the dependency-tracking and outgoing-edge range machinery used by the ranger. It defines range_def_chain for same-block SSA dependency/import tracking, gori_map for per-basic-block import/export sets, gori_compute for computing edge-induced operand ranges and conditional adjustments, and iteration macros/helpers for traversing GORI exports and imports.
same_name_distinction: Declares the GORI data structures and APIs—range_def_chain, gori_map, gori_compute, iteration helpers, and export/import traversal macros—that are implemented in gcc/gimple-range-gori.cc. Unlike the .cc file, it provides the structural interface for outgoing-range dependency analysis rather than its implementation.
